body: Hi @Senko-heart , thanks for the report. Since you have an MRP would you be willing to test this on more recent Godot versions to see if the issue still occurs? If it turns out that it has already been fixed then the best course of action would be to update to the fixed version. I think it is probably unlikely that 4.6 would receive a performance patch here since 4.8 is the current development version and 4.7 is the current stable version, but the number of breaking changes from 4.6 to 4.7 should hopefully be manageable: https://docs.godotengine.org/en/4.7/tutorials/migrating/upgrading_to_godot_4.7.html

@CreatedBySeb the issue persists up to the latest dev version

A little search reveals that scoped storage is slow, particularly for some operations (the article quotes file operations as 25-50x slower than regular):

https://www.xda-developers.com/android-q-storage-access-framework-scoped-storage/

This may be dependent on the Android device and version.

Whether it should be *this* slow, can't say.

User is recommended to use the `user://` path, as this doesn't use scoped storage, so should be much faster. This could even be the only difference (i.e. minimal differences on the Godot side), haven't looked though.
Could potentially be a repeat of #63434 over Godot 4

From what I could find, [people recommend using DocumentsContract for better performance](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/77560211/documentfile-canwrite-documentfile-exists-poor-performance-takes-too-muc)
